title: Fitch Ratings and Its Recent Assessments
description: Fitch Ratings, a global leader in credit rating and research, has been in the news for its recent evaluations of financial entities and cities.

sections.heading: New York City's Rating
paragraphs: According to Bloomberg.com, New York City has been spared from a downgrade by Fitch and Moody’s for the time being.

sections.heading: New York City's Bond Rating
paragraphs: Fitch has rated New York City's $1.5 billion Fiscal 2027 Ser A GO Bonds 'Aa', with the outlook remaining negative, as reported by TradingView.

sections.heading: Agibank Upgrade
paragraphs: Stock Titan reported that Fitch upgraded Agibank to an AA(bra) rating for Agi Inc (NYSE: AGBK).

faq.a: Fitch Ratings is a credit rating agency that provides credit ratings, research, and analysis.

faq.q: Why are Fitch Ratings in the news?
faq.a: Fitch Ratings has been in the news due to its recent assessments of New York City's credit rating and Agibank's upgrade.
